name: Sharezer
bio: Sharezer, son of Sennacherib, king of Assyria, struck his father down with the sword along with his brother Adrammelech while Sennacherib was worshipping in the house of his god Nisroch. The two brothers then escaped to the land of Armenia, and another son, Esarhaddon, became king in Sennacherib's place (2 Kings 19:37).
